title: Digital Immunoassay Protocol for Solid-State Nanopore Sensing
protocol: Add 12 μL of each oligo for P1 and P2 in separate tubes, add 72 μL of 5x TAEMg buffer and deionized water to reach a total reaction volume of 360 μL.
Vortex the samples.
Divide and transfer each sample into 4 PCR tubes.
Place the samples in a thermal cycler such as the MiniAmp Plus Thermal Cycler (Applied Biosystems, A37834).
Incubate samples at 95°C for 5 minutes then cool to 90°C.
Ramp down from 90°C to 60°C at 0.4°C/min.
Ramp down from 60°C to 26°C at 0.03°C/min.
Snap cool the samples to 4°C indefinitely.
Prepare 50 mL of 0.5x TBE in an Erlenmeyer flask.
Weigh out and add 1 g of agarose to the 0.5x TBE buffer to make a 2% gel solution.
Microwave for 15-30 seconds at a time until the agarose is completely dissolved, approximately 2 minutes and 30 seconds total.
Let the agarose cool.
Add 5 μL of 10,000x GelRed to the agarose solution and gently mix.
Pour the agarose solution into the gel tray and insert comb.
Allow the agarose to solidify for 20 minutes.
Pool the DNA nanostructure probes from four PCR tubes after assembly.
Mix 0.5 μL of each DNA nanostructure probe with 9.5 μL of deionized water and 2 μL of 6x Loading buffer for gel characterization.
Load the samples on a 2% agarose gel, run at 70 V for approximately 1 hour, then visualize on Gel imaging workstation (Azure biosystems, C150).
Store remaining probe at 4°C.
Take 90 μL of assembled DNA probe (P1/P2), add 14 μL of 5x TAEMg and 15 μL of 10x GelRed to the mixture.
Add 25 μL of 6x Loading Buffer and 26 μL of deionized water to the mixture, then vortex.
Load the samples into wells of a 5% Mini-PROTEAN TBE polyacrylamide pre-cast gel.
Run the gel in 0.5x TBE buffer at 100 V on ice for 3 hours.
Take the gels out of cassettes and visualize using gel imager (Azure biosystems, C150) UV plate.
Identify the band of interest and excise with a razor blade.
Place the excised gel slices in custom extraction apparatus or D-Tube Dialyzer Maxi tubes.
Apply 100 V in 1x TBE buffer to electrophoretically extract DNA samples out of gel slices.
Take the supernatant from the extraction tubes.
Perform buffer exchange into 1x TAEMg using Amicon Ultra-0.5 Centrifugal Filter Units.
Quantify the purified probes by taking 2 μL of the sample and performing nucleic acid concentration measurements with a UV-Visible spectrophotometer.
Take equimolar concentrations of purified DNA nanostructure probes fixed at either 15 nM or 20 nM.
Add various amounts of junction strands ranging from 0.2 nM to 400 nM for dumbbell assembly.
Incubate the samples for up to two days at room temperature.
Confirm the quality of dumbbell formation on a 2% agarose gel.
Take 4 μL of the assembled dumbbell samples.
Add 35.5 μL of 3.6 M LiCl and 0.5 μL 2kbp dsDNA fragments to the sample.
Vortex the sample thoroughly.
Load the vortexed sample into the nanopore flow cell (cis side).
Apply -100 mV and sense on a nanopore for 10 - 30 minutes.
Add 234 μg of primary antibody to the Amicon Ultra-0.5 Centrifugal Filter Unit.
Add Bead Conjugation Buffer to reach a final volume of 500 μL in the filter unit.
Centrifuge at 14,000 g for 5 minutes, discard flow-through, and wash with 450 μL Bead Conjugation Buffer.
Repeat the 450 μL washes three times.
Invert the filter unit membrane and centrifuge into a new tube at 1,000 g for 2 minutes.
Rinse the filter unit membrane by adding another 50 μL of Bead Conjugation Buffer and centrifuging at 1,000 g for 2 minutes.
Collect the sample and measure protein concentration using the Take3 micro-volume plate accessory.
Add enough Bead Conjugation Buffer to dilute the sample to 0.3 mg/mL.
Store the antibody sample on ice.
Take 300 μL of carboxylated paramagnetic beads and resuspend by vortexing.
Briefly centrifuge the sample using pulse spin setting and place solution on magnet for >1 minute, remove supernatant.
Add 600 μL of Bead Wash Buffer to resuspend beads.
Wash beads three times using Bead Wash Buffer, vortexing each time before placing on magnet and removing buffer.
Add 600 μl of Bead Conjugation Buffer (Quanterix, 101357) to resuspend beads, retain beads with magnet, and remove buffer.
Repeat washes three times using Bead Conjugation Buffer, vortexing each time before placing on magnet and removing buffer.
Add 570 μl of the Bead Conjugation Buffer and store on ice.
Mix 1 mg vial of EDC (ThermoFisher Scientific, A35391) with 100 μl of Bead Conjugation Buffer, vortex to mix.
Incubate activated paramagnetic beads with EDAC for 30 minutes on shaker (VWR, PTR-35).
Pulse spin using tabletop centrifuge (VWR, 76269-064), and wash activated paramagnetic beads with 600 μl Bead Conjugation Buffer.
Incubate prepared buffer exchanged primary antibody with activated paramagnetic beads for 2 hours on shaker.
Pulse spin the paramagnetic bead/primary antibody solution, place on magnet, collect supernatant and label as “supernatant”.
Wash beads with 600 μL Bead Wash Buffer, collect supernatant and label as “wash 1”.
Measure protein concentrations of supernatant and wash 1 using EPOC 2 spectrophotometer.
Compare values to total amount of antibody loaded to estimate total antibody coated and percentage antibody coated.
Perform another wash with Bead Wash Buffer, then discard the supernatant.
Add 600 μL of Bead Blocking Buffer and incubate for 30 minutes on Multi-Functional Tube Rotator at 5 rpm.
Wash beads using 600 μL of Bead Wash Buffer.
Perform two more washes using 600 μL of Bead Diluent, resuspend in 600 μL Bead Diluent and store at 4°C.
Take 62.5 μL (100 μg) of secondary antibody and add 37.5 μL of 1x PBS to have secondary antibody at 1 μg/μL in 100 μL.
Add 10 μL of Modifier reagent to 100 μL of secondary antibody.
Add the above 100 μL sample to lyophilized Streptavidin Mix, pipette up and down to have material fully dissolved.
Incubate at room temperature for 3 hours.
Add 10 μL of Quencher to the reaction.
Incubate the solution at room temperature for 30 minutes.
Confirm the quality of the conjugation using native gel with Mini-PROTEAN TGX gels in 1x Tris/Glycine Buffer at 100 V.
Store the solution at 4°C.
Take 72 μL (7.2×10^7) of prepared bead-capture antibody conjugates, add Sample Diluent to a total volume of 500 μL.
Place the tube on the magnet and remove supernatant.
Perform two more 500 μL washes.
Add various amounts (0.8 fM to 1.2 nM) of recombinant TSH (rTSH) and bring the volume up to 500 μL with Sample Diluent or diluted human serum sample.
Incubate for 1 hour at room temperature on Multi-Functional Tube Rotator at 5 rpm.
Place the tube on the magnet for >1 min, and remove supernatant.
Add 500 μL of Wash Buffer 1, and incubate for 5 minutes on Multi-Functional Tube Rotator at 5 rpm.
Place the tube on the magnet for >1 min, and remove supernatant.
Add 500 μL of Wash Buffer 1, and incubate for 10 minutes on Multi-Functional Tube Rotator at 5 rpm.
Place the tube on the magnet for >1 min, and remove supernatant.
Add 500 μL of Wash Buffer 1, and incubate for 15 minutes on Multi-Functional Tube Rotator at 5 rpm.
Place the tube on the magnet for >1 min, and remove supernatant.
Place the tube on the magnet for >1 min.
Remove the supernatant.
Resuspend in 500 μL of Sample Diluent containing 6 nM secondary antibody-streptavidin conjugate.
OPTION 1: For the amplification assay, add 10 μL of AuNP amplification complex to a final volume of 50 μL in Sample Diluent.
Incubate for 1 hour on Multi-Functional Tube Rotator at 5 rpm at room temperature.
Perform three 30 sec washes with 1x Wash Buffer 1, and resuspend in 500 μL of Sample Diluent.
OPTION 1: For the amplification assay, skip this step.
Add 12 nM of biotinylated ssDNA junction strand.
Incubate for 15 min at room temperature on Multi-Functional Tube Rotator at 5 rpm.
Perform three 30 sec washes with 1x Wash Buffer 1, and resuspend in 500 μL of 1x TAEMg buffer containing 0.025 % Tween-20.
OPTION 1: For the amplification assay, resuspend in 20 μL of 1x PBS containing 0.025 % Tween-20.
Apply UV using a 3W LED flashlight at a distance of 1 cm for 20 minutes to release the ssDNA junction strand.
OPTION 1: For the amplification assay, release the junction strand by incubation for 45 minutes in 0.2 M DTT.
Place samples on the magnet for more than one minute.
Transfer supernatant to a 3 kDa Amicon Ultra-0.5 Centrifugal Filter Unit (Millipore Sigma, UFC500396).
Perform buffer exchange and concentrate ssDNA junction strands into 35 μL of 1x TAEMg containing 0.025% Tween-20.
Add purified shooting star probes at either 15 or 20 nM final concentrations.
Incubate at room temperature for up to two days for dumbbell assembly.
Take thiolated ssDNA oligos and perform three washes of 1x PBS using a 3 kDa Amicon Ultra-0.5 Centrifugal Filter Unit (Millipore Sigma, UFC500396) to have final concentration of 10 μM in 1x PBS.
Prepare 0.3 M NaH2PO4 containing 0.2 M DTT solution (ThermoFisher Scientific, A39255).
Mix 250 μL of buffer-exchanged DNA oligo with 250 μL of 0.3 M NaH2PO4 and 0.2 M DTT.
Incubate at room temperature for two hours.
Take a NAP-5 column (GE Healthcare, 17185601), remove all caps, and let storage buffer flow through.
Equilibrate the NAP-5 column with 10 mL deionized water.
Add reduced DNA sample to the column and allow sample to fully enter membrane.
Add 1 mL deionized water to elute purified sample.
Reduce the volume to 200 μL using a 3 kDa Amicon Ultra-0.5 Centrifugal Filter Unit.
Adjust the final concentration of the sample to 25 μM with deionized water.
Split the sample into 50 μL aliquots and store at -20°C.
Take 960 μL of 30 nm AuNP, add 40 μL of 0.1 M borate buffer to adjust pH to 9.
Add 4 μg of secondary antibody to a tube, then add the adjusted AuNP solution.
Incubate at room temperature for 30 minutes.
Add 25 μL of reduced ssDNA oligos and incubate for 1 hour.
Increase salt concentration to 0.15 M NaCl by adding 6 additions of 1 M NaCl every 30 min.
Incubate at 4°C overnight (optional pause point).
Add 50 μL of 10% BSA and incubate for 5 minutes.
Centrifuge at 4,500 g for 15 minutes; discard supernatant.
Add 950 μL of 1x PBS containing 0.025% v/v Tween-20, resuspend by gentle shaking or vortexing.
Repeat steps of centrifugation and resuspension two times.
Add 150 μL of 1x PBS containing 0.025% v/v Tween-20.
Store the sample at 4°C.
